<issue>
Node listing output format changed unexpectedly

#### Description

When using the `--print-nodes` option with ARXML files, the output format has changed. Node names are now printed with semicolons instead of colons, and comment formatting has changed from square brackets to parentheses.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load an ARXML file and list nodes
db = cantools.database.load_file('tests/files/arxml/system-4.2.arxml')
# Use cantools list command with --print-nodes flag
```

Expected output:
```
Driver:
  Comment[DE]: Der rätselhafte Fahrer
  Comment[EN]: The enigmatic driver
Passenger:
  Comment[FOR-ALL]: A boring passenger
  Comment[DE]: Ein langweiliger Passagier
```

Actual output:
```
Driver;
  Comment(DE): Der rätselhafte Fahrer
  Comment(EN): The enigmatic driver
Passenger;
  Comment(FOR-ALL): A boring passenger
  Comment(DE): Ein langweiliger Passagier
```

The node names should end with colons (`:`) not semicolons (`;`), and comments should use square brackets `[lang]` not parentheses `(lang)`.
</issue>
